params.write_outputs: Whether to output intermediate artifacts such as CSVs/images
params.write_excel: Whether to output the Excel report

params.approved_col: Approval flag field, default approved; 1 is approved, 0 is rejected
params.score_col: Pre-score field used by reject inference, default prescore_prob
params.feature_cols: List of model features; when empty, numeric columns are selected automatically, excluding fields such as target/approved/score/split
params.split_col: Optional sample split field, supports ins/oos/oot; ins/oos enter RI training, and oot is used only for evaluation

level2.name: Pre-Score Switch

params.train_prescore: Whether to train a pre-score model; when true, an existing score_col is overwritten
params.prescore_model_type: Pre-score model type, supports lgb/xgb/cat/lr, default lgb

rules: target_col must exist when train_prescore=true or the input lacks score_col
If ri_approved_data lacks score_col, the same prescore model is used to fill in the score
When train_prescore=false and no score filling is trained, both the main data and the external RI reference must already have score_col

params.ri_method_params: Independent parameter dict for each RI method
params.ri_score_direction: Score direction; high_bad means the higher the score, the higher the risk, and high_good means the higher the score, the better

simple_augment.bad_rate: Bad rate of the random pseudo-labels for rejected cases; when empty, estimated from the reference sample

hard_cutoff.cutoff: Hard-cut threshold; when empty, derived from the quantiles of the approved bad scores according to ri_score_direction

fuzzy_augment.weight_factor: Weight scaling factor for the good/bad double rows of rejected cases, default 1.0

level2.name: Reference Sample Source

params.ri_approved_data: External approved DataFrame, used only for estimating the RI rules
params.ri_approved_query: A pandas query that selects the RI reference from the main data's approved samples
params.ri_approved_func: A function that selects the RI reference from the main data's approved samples
params.ri_approved_frac: Share to randomly sample from the reference
params.ri_approved_n: Number of rows to randomly sample from the reference

rules: ri_approved_data cannot be used together with ri_approved_query/ri_approved_func
ri_approved_frac and ri_approved_n cannot be used together
ri_approved_scope=output_subset cannot be used together with an external ri_approved_data
Under reference_only, the final augmented sample still outputs all approved + rejected inferred of the main data
Under output_subset, the final augmented sample outputs the filtered approved + rejected inferred

params.train_ri_models: Whether to train a follow-up model on each RI-augmented sample
params.ri_model_type: Post-RI model type, supports lgb/xgb/cat/lr, default lgb
params.lr_nan_handling: Missing-value handling for features of the lr model (prescore/post-RI model): fillna_median (default)/fillna_mean/fillna_0 fill with train-side statistics, which are saved with the model and reused when scoring; raise forbids filling and raises an error directly on NaN/Inf. GBM families are unaffected (they support NaN natively)
params.include_no_ri_benchmark: Whether to add an approved-only benchmark that does no RI
params.ri_validation_frac: Share of validation drawn from the approved training pool when there is no OOS

level2.name: OOT and Performance Evaluation

params.oot_data: External OOT DataFrame; takes precedence over split_col and oot_frac
params.oot_frac: Share of OOT split randomly from approved when there is no oot_data/split_col OOT

rules: Unperformed samples with an empty oot_data target_col are filtered automatically with a warning
When split_col exists, ins/oos are used for training and validation, and oot only for evaluation
oot_data takes precedence over split_col==oot, which takes precedence over oot_frac

params.save_models: Whether to save the prescore and post-RI model pkl files
params.model_output_dir: Model output directory; when empty, output_dir/models is used
params.model_include_metadata: Whether to use the save_model metadata envelope

params.write_ri_datasets: Whether to write each RI-augmented sample
params.ri_dataset_output_cols: Output only the specified columns; when empty, all columns are output
params.ri_dataset_warn_mb: A warning is issued when the estimated memory of the augmented sample exceeds this many MB

requirement_note: The required category contains the data-field entry points that RI must confirm; feature_cols can be inferred automatically, but the approved/target/score basis needs to be confirmed.

prescore_params.passes_to: lgb/xgb/cat use GradientBoostingModel.fit; lr uses LRMaster.fit
prescore_params.accepted_params: Uses the model parameters corresponding to prescore_model_type; the default parameters are isolated per model, with the corresponding random seed filled in

ri_model_params.passes_to: lgb/xgb/cat use GradientBoostingModel.fit; lr uses LRMaster.fit
ri_model_params.accepted_params: Uses the model parameters corresponding to ri_model_type; the _weight of fuzzy_augment is passed to GBMs as sample_weight and to LR as weight_col

bad_rate.meaning: Pseudo-label bad rate for rejected cases; None uses the approved average bad rate

cutoff.default: The Pipeline estimates it automatically according to ri_score_direction
cutoff.meaning: Under high_bad, score>=cutoff is judged bad; under high_good, score<=cutoff is judged bad

weight_factor.meaning: Weight scaling of the good/bad double rows of rejected cases

n_parcels.meaning: Number of approved bins; rejected cases are binned with the same boundaries

weight_col.pipeline_value: _weight only when true RI weight exists
